label: common_2100_head_teacher_01
text: Excellent. It seems everyone is here.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2100_head_teacher_02
text: Some of you will certainly have heard the\nhappy news.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2100_head_teacher_03a
text: We have a new Champion here at Naranja\nAcademy![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2100_head_teacher_03b
text: We have a new Champion here at Uva Academy![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2100_head_teacher_04
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Yes, none other than our very own M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2100_head_teacher_05
text: It gives me great joy to see one of our students\nachieve this feat during their time at the academy.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2100_head_teacher_06
text: Today’s tournament was organized by your\nstudent council president, Miss Nemona, in\r\ncelebration of her friend’s accomplishment.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2100_head_teacher_07
text: I invite all of you here to see for yourselves the\nimpressive strength of our new Champion.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2100_head_teacher_08
text: Not to mention the talents of those students\nclaiming the spotlight for the first time today...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2100_head_teacher_09
text: And, of course, the superb battle prowess and\nacumen of our esteemed faculty.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2100_head_teacher_10
text: Now, without further ado, let the Academy Ace\nTournament—our School Battle Brawl—begin![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
